lesson.subtitle: Lesson 21 -- What the Fee Covers
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Fábia | Lesson 21 -- What the Fee Covers

listenings.text: Well, the fee covers the usual things, you know, the normal accounting work. Some other things are not in it, it depends. We can help with almost everything, I think. And if you need something more, we talk about the price later.

Our monthly fee covers bookkeeping, payroll and your tax returns. However, it does not cover audits. Although we do not do audits, we work with a partner firm that does. And additional work, like opening a new branch, has its own price.
